rc_exoskeleton_high_rebound_tpu.structural_purpose: Indestructible flexible RC kinetic shock bumper airframe. Enhanced to 6 wall loops to handle brutal friction scrapes against concrete curbs, ensuring the built-in grasshopper suspension loops maintain perfect spring rebound velocity.

rc_spine_carbon_fiber_nylon.structural_purpose: Rigid internal electronics and motor mount platform. Sliced at 100% solid concentric density in PA-CF to completely eliminate flex torsion along the drivetrain, keeping the motor gear mesh locked solid under high battery acceleration bursts.
